story: A breakaway of five riders was caught 25 km from the finish. Axel van der Tuuk launched an attack in the last 2 km, followed by four others. The quartet caught Van der Tuuk and sprinted for victory, with the peloton closing in but arriving too late. Francisco Campos won the sprint.
